{{Quote|No more questions, Solo. Just be happy you made it out of here with your life&hellip;and your precious spaceship.|Verhandle to Han Solo|<ref name="Star Wars: The Art of the Bad Deal" />}}
'''Verhandle''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminal around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. At some point during his life, Verhandle met the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]. After collecting various cargo items, Solo wanted to sell the items to Verhandle at a price that did not suit well for Verhandle, who bought the items for sixty percent of the original agreed fee. The criminal had a [[Verhandle's soldiers|group]] of [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] working for him and dispatched them to commandeer Solo's [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Verhandle, my friend! Long time no see!''"<br />"''Solo.|Solo and Verhandle|<ref name="Star Wars: The Art of the Bad Deal" />}}
Verhandle, a [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminal, was a [[Sentience/Legends|being]] that lived around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In order to protect himself, Verhandle recruited a group of [[Verhandle's soldiers|group]] of [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]]. At some point, Verhandle met the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], and began a deal with the smuggler. Solo and his [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Pilot/Legends|copilot]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] collected various cargo items to [[Mission to unidentified planet|sell]] to Verhandle on a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. The price for the cargo items did not interest Verhandle, who lowered the price from its original fee to sixty percent. After Solo agreed, Verhandle took the items. Unbeknownst to Solo and Chewbacca, the criminal secretly dispatched a group of his soldiers to commandeer Solo's [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. The soldiers, however, were defeated by Chewbacca.<ref name="Star Wars: The Art of the Bad Deal" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|No, I do trust you, but Verhandle is one of the shadiest characters I've ever met.|Solo to Chewbacca|<ref name="Star Wars: The Art of the Bad Deal" />}}
Described to be a shady character by Han Solo, Verhandle did not keep his deal with Solo to buy his cargo goods. Instead of paying the original agreed upon fee, Verhandle lowered the price down to seventy-five percent. When Solo argued against it, Verhandle lowered it down to seventy and finally sixty percent. Verhandle was also interested in the ''Millennium Falcon'' and wanted to buy it from Solo.<ref name="Star Wars: The Art of the Bad Deal" />

==Behind the scenes==
Verhandle first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' themed [[Free Comic Book Day|one-shot comic]] [[The Art of the Bad Deal|''Star Wars: The Art of the Bad Deal'']], which was penned by [[Zack Whedon]].
